plainLanguage: The upper part of the chest muscle works during a dumbbell fly.
qualifiers: The supporting studies used two-channel instrumentation and report no numeric activation values in their retrievable text.
Electromyography measures activation, not force and not growth.
A dumbbell fly is a related condition, not the index bilateral standing cable fly at shoulder height.

conditions: dumbbell fly performed across several modalities; loads not standardised across the source studies

sourceLinks.locator: Abstract (all four modalities of the frontal-lateral cross with dumbbells developed high action-potential levels for both muscles)
Abstract (clavicular pectoralis activity compared between rowing modalities and the frontal-lateral cross with dumbbells)

statement: The clavicular portion of the pectoralis major is activated during a dumbbell fly.
